card.name: Partway through long split words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a longer word that is split into several parts, such as ADOLE|SC|ENTS, extrav|as|ation, flo|pp|ies, syring|es. It mostly appears in medical warnings and drug text.

modes.label: Boxed warning words
modes.description: Middle piece of capitalised words in suicidality warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL IDEATION IN CHILDREN AND ADOLE<<SC>>ENTS Atomoxetine increased the risk of suicidal

modes.label: Extravasation
modes.description: The middle piece of extravasation when it is split into parts.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Middle piece of other uncommon words such as floppies or syringes.
modes.example: this can also be done with MS-DOS flo<<pp>>ies using sysutils/mtools package

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long or rare words that get cut into pieces, like adolescents or extravasation.
